description: This file defines a Flutter widget named `OnScreenKeyboard`, which implements a TV-friendly on-screen keyboard designed for DPAD navigation. It provides an interface to show a fullscreen modal with a grid of keys (characters and actions), handles focus traversal and key events, and emits callbacks for user interactions such as submitting or canceling the input.

classes.name: OnScreenKeyboard
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a fullscreen on-screen keyboard with a title, text buffer, and associated callbacks for user interactions.

classes.name: _OnScreenKeyboardState
classes.description: State class managing the internal buffer, focus nodes, key grid, and build logic for `OnScreenKeyboard`.

classes.name: _KeySpec
classes.description: Represents a key (character or action) on the keyboard with label, value, and behavior.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to show the keyboard as a modal dialog, returning the entered text or null if canceled.

methods.name: _buildKeys
methods.description: Builds the list of keys (characters and actions) shown in the keyboard grid.

methods.name: _notifyChanged
methods.description: Calls the `onChanged` callback with the current buffer.

methods.name: _append
methods.description: Appends a character to the buffer.

methods.name: _backspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from the buffer.

methods.name: _space
methods.description: Adds a space character to the buffer.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Calls the `onSubmitted` callback with the current buffer.

methods.name: _handleBack
methods.description: Handles hardware back or escape key presses to allow cancellation.

methods.name: _previewText
methods.description: Returns the text preview, masked if `obscurePreview` is true.

methods.name: _activateKey
methods.description: Handles the logic when a key is activated (tapped or focused and pressed Enter).
